basis: Strategy returns. Historical prices reconstruct the uninterrupted strategy during the pause; these are not broker-account returns. Published history through August 2026 is retained. September onward follows the same research price-fill convention: RSI(14) 30/70, BB(20) midpoint, 2.5 ATR stop, 24 bars, half risk for shared currencies, one pip assumed round-trip cost. 1R = 1 percentage point; returns are additive. Exits use the UTC exit-bar month. Executable bid/ask, slippage and rollover limit fills can differ. Open strategy trades are excluded.
